title: Container Bookings: amount condition for goodwill on a customer roll fee
content:
## Rule
A goodwill waiver of a Container Bookings customer roll fee is granted only when the fee entry's amount is above 0.00 and does not exceed the tier's goodwill waiver limit, that is, the largest single fee entry the desk may waive as goodwill on that tier.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical limit)
*Hypothetical goodwill waiver limit of 150.00, for illustration only:*
| Fee entry amount | Above 0.00 | Not above the limit | Amount condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | no | yes | not met |
| 149.99 | yes | yes | met |
| 150.00 | yes | yes | met |
| 150.01 | yes | no | not met |

## Points of judgement
**The fee entry is larger than the limit. Can the part up to the limit be waived?** No. The amount condition is not met, and a waiver always covers the whole entry.

**The fee entry is 0.00.** The amount condition is not met, since the amount must be above 0.00.
